instruction.text: Choose the correct answer to the problem.

atoms.a: Peter has £5,450. He sells an old car and gets paid £1,000. How much does he have now?
Peter now has £6,450. He spends £3,000 on a new car. How much does he have now?
Julie is running a race. Her last race was 1,500 metres. Her next race is 1,000 metres longer. How long is her next race?
Julie’s friend will be running in a separate race at the same time, which is 5,000 metres longer than Julie’s 2,500-meter race. How long is Julie’s friend’s race?
Mara is going skiing. At the top of a mountain, the altitude is 3,458 metres. She then skis down 2,000 metres of slope. What altitude is she at now?
Mara is queueing for a chairlift. At the chairlift, she is at an altitude of 87 metres. The chairlift carries her 1,000 metres up a mountain. What altitude is she at now?
Eleanor is preparing to swim the English Channel. Her last practice swim was 2,280 metres. Her next practice swim will be 1,000 metres longer. How far will she swim next time?
After this, Eleanor’s next practice swim will be 6,290 metres. The week after her swim will be 2,000 metres longer. How far will this swim be?
